summary: Consolidation/hardening-only phase reviewing the entire Advisory Repository Skills subsystem (115P-115Y) end to end. Confirms: responsibilities clearly separated with no duplication (AdvisoryRepositorySkill/RepositoryConsistencyAdvisorySkill for skill invocation, build_advisory_request for prompt assembly, AdvisoryProvider/MockAdvisoryProvider/CurrentActingModelAdvisoryProvider for backend-agnostic invocation, normalize_advisory_response for normalization, build_evidence_from_normalized for evidence construction, AdvisoryContextPackage for bounded context assembly); no hidden coupling into decision_evaluation.py, repository_transition_validator.py, any lifecycle command, notification_certification.py, handoff_verification.py, post_push_canonicalization.py, runtime_inspect.py, repository_skills_integration.py, or repository_transition_integration.py; no circular dependencies (advisory_context_package.py has zero internal pcae imports; advisory_repository_skills.py and current_acting_model_advisory_provider.py form a clean one-directional chain terminating in evidence.py/paths.py/repository_skills.py); no authority leakage (no decide/authorize/commit/push/finalize/notify/mutate/execute/approve/reject method on any public class, no TransitionVerdict import, no execution primitive in source). All five extension points (AdvisoryProvider, RepositorySkill/AdvisoryRepositorySkill, EvidenceProvider, AdvisoryContextPackage, DecisionEvaluation) verified stable against their frozen contracts. Containment reconfirmed with executable tests: cannot authorize, cannot execute, cannot mutate the repository (git log identical before/after skill invocation against a disposable repo), cannot bypass the Repository Transition Validator, cannot bypass response normalization; execution capability remains unavailable per pcae runtime inspect and collect_evidence_via_repository_skills(). Architecture consistency reviewed across all ten phase reports (115P-115Y) and six canonical documents: terminology consistent, the pilot advisory question quoted identically everywhere, same-model-default terminology consistent, cross-phase references accurate, the Recommended Next Phase chain unbroken end to end, Mermaid diagrams internally consistent, execution-unavailable confirmation present in every document. Implementation consistency confirmed: all three prototypes still match their frozen contracts (RepositorySkillManifest shape, AI_REVIEW capability + model_produced=True, CurrentActingModelAdvisoryProvider's provider_id/backend_kind/determinism/invoke shape, AdvisoryContextPackage's one allowed question + four trust classes, default Repository Skills registry unchanged at four deterministic skills). Explicitly scopes every check to the three real subsystem modules (advisory_repository_skills.py, current_acting_model_advisory_provider.py, advisory_context_package.py), distinct from two unrelated pre-existing systems: Phase 88X's advisory.py (read-only Advisory mode / would-* decision layer over Permission Broker evidence) and Phase 113C's advisory_runtime.py (observation-only Advisory Runtime capability results) -- neither referenced, modified, or conflated. Remaining architectural debt documented across four categories, all pre-existing and deliberate, none a defect: documentation (none major); implementation (AdvisoryContextPackage not yet wired into the live pipeline, no live/automated model-invocation mechanism, no automatic redaction scanning -- all explicit prior-phase scope boundaries); optimization (none identified); future capability (second Advisory Provider, additional advisory question types beyond repository-consistency review, split-model mode -- all previously deferred in 115U/115Q/115W). Declares the Advisory Repository Skills subsystem a stable v0.2 subsystem of PCAE with its extension points frozen. Adds tests/test_phase_115z_advisory_subsystem_hardening.py (95 new architecture-verification tests). No new feature, no new Evidence Provider, no new Repository Skill, no new Advisory Provider, no second Advisory Provider, no Decision Evaluation/Repository Transition Validator/lifecycle command/Notification Policy/Repository State Kernel modification. No execution, no authorization, no Permission Broker enforcement, no plugins, no Telegram inbound, no REST, no Dashboard, no Web UI. Execution capability remains unavailable.
